clusters.executionModeRationale: Single-cluster serial execution. US-002 reads the source-of-truth structure produced by US-001 to keep the hand-fork mirror in lockstep; US-003's parity gate test exercises both surfaces from US-001/US-002; US-004 stamps the v5.46.1 release across five manifests; US-005 pushes. Tier-1 risk per docs/parallel-safety.md — plugin state files and release stamps are strictly serial.
